regime.value: ES and NQ 1h/4h were in a pullback down from the mid-Feb highs, with lower highs into the Feb 20 low (ES 4968.25). On 21 Feb (5m), price chopped about 4968-4987 ES until 14:00 ET, made a low of about 4959 ES / 17373.25 NQ around 14:45-15:20 ET, then rallied hard after 15:20 (ES >5000 by 16:00, about 5040 overnight). By the recording on 22 Feb, ES 4h was back at the highs (~5064).

quality_notes: Prices and levels come from position-tool and line labels (reliable). ES target is derived from the tooltip R:R because its label is under the webcam. Entry times come from box left edges, ±5 min. The result is the main weak point: no fill, exit or P&L panel is shown. The ES 'Closed P&L -6.50' is TradingView's calculation on the drawn box, not an account fill. NQ's stop-out is inferred from candles about 5 pts above the stop. The transcript is heavily garbled, especially 00:00-00:45 and 02:00-04:15, so whether he took partials, closed manually or was stopped cannot be confirmed by ear.
